content:
anya-sec: heads-up, high-sev. After the 02:00 KMS rewrap we saw embeddings requests accepted using tokens that only had chat scopes. This looks like an authz enforcement regression during the rewrap window.

anya-sec: example log:```
[2026-04-12T02:01:12.345Z] req=8f3d token_id=svc-abc scopes=[chat:generate] route=/v1/embeddings model=text-embed-small status=200 resp_tokens=1
```

mike-ops: confirmed. Cloudwatch aggregate shows ~1.2k /v1/embeddings calls in a 90s spike, ~0.8% succeeded with chat-only tokens. Customers flagged for unexpected embeddings usage.

jordan-ml: fwiw the embedding path is batched by the worker pool. Could be a shared cache or a per-worker scope-map that got stale during rewrap and allowed fallback to route-level compatibility.

jordan-ml: quick hypothesis: token->scope tag is stored as KMS tag -> during rewrap some tags were momentarily missing and the batching layer falls back to `route:allowlist` which currently treats chat+ as compatible with embeddings if model family overlaps.

carol-sre: can someone post repro steps? I'll try a staging run.

anya-sec: repro steps that matched prod:
1) create token with only `chat:generate`
2) call /v1/embeddings in a tight loop (concurrency 8) while we run a rewrap on the KMS metadata cache (simulate tag eviction)
3) watch for 200s.

carol-sre: reproed in staging with short window. log snippet from staging:```
[2026-04-12T14:05:03.210Z] req=aa11 token=svc-test scopes=[chat:generate] route=/v1/embeddings model=text-embed-small status=200
[2026-04-12T14:05:03.211Z] worker=pool-3 cached_scope_map=missing fallback=route_compat_v1
```

kms-bot: KMS rewrap job completed at 2026-04-12T02:00:00Z. Rewrapped 1,243,219 keys. Tag preservation: success for 99.988% keys, failure (tag drop) observed for 0.012% due to transient API rate errors. Affected keys listed in kms-rewrap/error-20260412.log.

sam-eng: immediate mitigation roadmap: 1) disable route_compat_v1 fallback in runtime (hotfix PR #4021), 2) roll to 5% immediately, monitor 1min error/latency, 3) if green, 100% in 30m. I've opened #4021 and started the canary.

mike-ops: rolling canary now. Noting that disabling fallback will 403 some valid legacy tokens that relied on it. Need communication plan + quick token rotation for impacted customers.

anya-sec: security actions:
- enumerate tokens that succeeded during the window (query below) and contact owners.
- force-rotate any service tokens that had unexpected embeddings hits.
- mark incident for audit and attach KMS job logs + audit entries.

carol-sre: query we used to extract evidence (internal tools):
```sql
SELECT token_id, count(1) as hits, min(ts) as first_seen, max(ts) as last_seen
FROM request_logs
WHERE route = '/v1/embeddings' AND token_scope NOT LIKE '%embeddings%' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-04-12T01:59:00Z' AND '2026-04-12T02:05:00Z'
GROUP BY token_id
ORDER BY hits DESC
LIMIT 500;
```

infra-bot: alerted owners for 78 tokens via PagerDuty incident INC-20260412-emb-scope.

jordan-ml: root cause theory: two issues in combination:
- KMS rewrap transiently dropped tags for a tiny subset of keys -> scope metadata unavailable
- runtime fallback logic (`route_compat_v1`) treats chat-model compatibility as permissive for embeddings when model family overlaps and cache miss occurs.

sam-eng: plan to fix permanently: 1) remove permissive compatibility (behavioral change) + add explicit per-model allowlist mapping, 2) make scope-check atomic with per-request tag validation and fail-closed on tag lookup errors, 3) add a feature-flagged safe-retry for tag lookups but do not fall back to permissive route-level allowlists. PRs: #4021 (hotfix), #4034 (hardening), #4040 (audit logging enrichment).

anya-sec: also need post-incident items:
- audit log enrichment: include token_kms_key_id and tag_version in every authz audit entry (owner: carol-sre).
- compliance writeup for SOC2: timeline + mitigation (owner: anya-sec).

mike-ops: timeline so far: 02:00 KMS job, 02:01 first anomalies, 02:05 canary rollback applied (hotfix started at 02:10), full rollout 02:40. Customers notified 04:00.

anya-sec: assign follow-ups: sam-eng -> fix and tests (ETA 4/13 COB), carol-sre -> audit logs & evidence (ETA 4/13 COB), jordan-ml -> compatibility matrix & unit tests (ETA 4/16), mike-ops -> token owner outreach & compliance artifact (ETA 4/14).

sam-eng: I'll post PR links and test results as soon as canary finishes. :thumbsup:

kms-bot: Follow-up: we've queued a re-run of the rewrap on affected keys with exponential backoff to ensure tags are preserved; will post results to kms-rewrap/fix-20260412.log once complete.

anya-sec: good work team. Marking incident sev=P1 for now. We'll collate all logs for the postmortem.

sam-eng: FYI PR #4021 rolled to 100% at 02:40; observed embeddings 403s for 99.9% of previously impacted tokens (expected). Rolling back permissive fallback removed the immediate risk. Next: test hardening PRs.
